BareIonicOperator.from_bundle(...).apply(displacement,vectors) is already factorized local FFT plus both nonlocal derivative sides; full physical target-PW output, no target diagonalization. Hardcoded ityp(2), displacement(6), local fields(nnr,6) and fixture flags must be replaced through a separately scoped material implementation, not gate deletion. UPF radial beta/angular labels/cutoff indices/PP_DIJ are source data. Number_of_proj in UPF is not the solid angular-expanded nkb; do not copy fixture nh/nkb or treat inactive padding as physical.
